title: Zelda: The Master Sword
body:
![Nimbu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32ce7015222543ea15fb62d5f1c9de8148cd9a1a.png)

Adds the Master Sword from The Legend of Zelda to Minecraft (particularly BotW/TotK).

 
Features:
- Powering up around enemies
- Recovering durability automatically after breaking

![Link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c414f59464e5d037db584bbb2b613a2f09fafb2_0.webp)
